name: OSS_COPY_MAP_ATTR_METADATA
description: This table stores the transformed attribute specific copy map metadata at run time.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_METADATA_ID
columns.description: System generated unique identifier to store the metadata id of the attribute.

columns.name: PARENT_OBJECT_METADATA_ID
columns.description: Identifies the parent metadata id corresponding to the attribute.

columns.name: TARGET_ATTRIBUTE
columns.description: Identifies the target view object attribute in copy map row.

columns.name: TARGET_COLUMN
columns.description: Identifies the column corresponding to the target attribute in the copy map row.

columns.name: SOURCE_ATTRIBUTE
columns.description: Identifies the source attribute in copy map row.

columns.name: SOURCE_COLUMN
columns.description: Identifies the column corresponding to the source attribute in the copy map row.

columns.name: FROM_EXPRESSION
columns.description: Identifies the from expression in copy map for the attribute row, if any.

columns.name: REFERENCE_ENTITY
columns.description: Identifies the referred entity for deriving the value of the attribute, if any.

columns.name: PRIMARY_KEY_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies if the attribute is a primary key. Stores Y or N.

columns.name: COPY_MAP_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Identifies the user specific session identifier for a specific copy map action.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
